input: Any commit that modifies /moves/$k.text for any Black agent must also modify /turn/ply.num in the same commit, must be signed by that piece, and must be co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents, so that a lone off-plan move from any piece, including king_e8, cannot be accepted.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/$k.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false)
